lines.speaker: Time Signal
lines.text: At the final pip, it will be exactly now. Precisely now. Now, give or take.

lines.speaker: Time Signal
lines.text: At the long tone, it will be later than you think, but not as late as you feared.

lines.speaker: Time Signal
lines.text: Following the pips, it will be one second later than it was a second ago. This service is provided free, as it always has been.

lines.speaker: Time Signal
lines.text: At the sixth pip, the time in every dimension will be slightly different. Please set your clock to whichever one you like best.

lines.speaker: Time Signal
lines.text: At the tone, it will be eleven o'clock on Every Possible News. It is always eleven o'clock there. Elsewhere, please use your judgement.

lines.speaker: Pleasure Boat Marjorie
lines.text: Mayday, mayday, mayday. This is the pleasure boat Marjorie. We are not in danger.

lines.speaker: Pleasure Boat Marjorie
lines.text: We are lost, and we have run out of biscuits. If anyone is passing, could they bring biscuits. Over.

lines.speaker: Automatic Beacon
lines.text: Automatic beacon. Distress level, mild. The crew of the survey ship Pemberton are locked out of the bridge.

lines.speaker: Automatic Beacon
lines.text: They are fine. They are having a picnic. Please send a locksmith, at your leisure.

lines.speaker: Balloon Persistence
lines.text: Pan pan. This is the hot air balloon Persistence. Our situation is stable, and has been for nine years.

lines.speaker: Balloon Persistence
lines.text: We are drifting gently over a dimension made of cloud. Please do not rescue us. We only wanted to say hello.

lines.speaker: Automatic Beacon
lines.text: Beacon, automatic. Somebody has let go of a balloon. It is red. It is rising steadily. It is safe, and very happy.

lines.speaker: Automatic Beacon
lines.text: This beacon is tied to the string. Hello from the balloon.

lines.speaker: Unknown Vessel
lines.text: S. O. S. Repeat, S. O. S. This is a small boat in a large sea. Correction. A large boat, in a small sea.

lines.speaker: Unknown Vessel
lines.text: We have run aground on all sides at once. Nobody is hurt. Everybody is embarrassed. Please advise.

lines.speaker: Test Transmission
lines.text: This is a test transmission. Normal programmes will resume shortly.

lines.speaker: Test Transmission
lines.text: They have been resuming shortly for some time. Please be patient. They are nearly ready.

lines.speaker: Test Transmission
lines.text: The tone you are hearing is one thousand cycles per second.

lines.speaker: Test Transmission
lines.text: Please adjust your set until the tone sounds friendly.

lines.speaker: Test Transmission
lines.text: The picture on your screen is a test card. It shows a bowl of fruit, a grey scale, and a small, brave dog.

lines.speaker: Test Transmission
lines.text: Adjust your set until the dog looks confident.

lines.speaker: Test Transmission
lines.text: This is a test transmission, from the gap between stations.

lines.speaker: Test Transmission
lines.text: Nothing is wrong. Nothing is on. Those are different things, and both of them are fine.

lines.speaker: Test Transmission
lines.text: This is a test transmission. If you are still watching this at this hour, the test is going very well.

lines.speaker: Test Transmission
lines.text: Thank you for your help. The dog says thank you too.
